message.content:
The episode where Del Boy falls through the bar is **"Yuppy Love"** — the first episode of Series 6 of *Only Fools and Horses*. It originally aired on **8th January 1989** on BBC1 and was watched by nearly 14 million viewers.

In this iconic scene, Del is in a wine bar trying to impress some female yuppies while chatting with Trigger. He tells Trigger to "play it nice and cool" and goes to lean on the bar, unaware that the barman has lifted the bar flap. Del falls straight through, much to the amusement of viewers. Trigger looks around wondering where Del has gone.

The scene was reportedly based on a real-life incident where writer John Sullivan knew someone who went to lean on a pub bar not realising the flap had been lifted. This moment has since been voted the greatest *Only Fools and Horses* scene of all time in multiple polls.

The episode also introduced Cassandra Parry, Rodney's future wife, as Rodney attends evening classes and pretends to live in a posh house to impress her.
